name: Region and Layout Management
description: Managing custom regions and repository layout positions in collections

scenarios.description: User creates a custom region in a collection
User updates properties of an existing region
User deletes a region and cleans up member assignments

template.summary: Deleted region {{input.regionId}} and cleaned up {{output.assignmentsCleaned}} assignments

scenarios.description: User assigns a repository to a custom region

events.repository.region.assign: Assigned repository {{input.repositoryId}} to region {{input.regionId}} in collection {{input.collectionId}} in {{duration.ms}}ms

scenarios.description: User updates repository position in the overworld map

events.repository.position.update: Updated position for repository {{input.repositoryId}} to grid position ({{input.gridX}}, {{input.gridY}}) in collection {{input.collectionId}} in {{duration.ms}}ms

scenarios.description: System batch initializes layout (regions, assignments, positions) to reduce re-renders

template.summary: Batch initialized layout: {{input.regionsCount}} regions, {{input.assignmentsCount}} assignments, {{input.positionsCount}} positions

events.layout.batch.initialize: Batch initialized layout for collection {{input.collectionId}}{{#input.regionsCount}} ({{input.regionsCount}} regions{{/input.regionsCount}}{{#input.assignmentsCount}}, {{input.assignmentsCount}} assignments{{/input.assignmentsCount}}{{#input.positionsCount}}, {{input.positionsCount}} positions{{/input.positionsCount}}) in {{duration.ms}}ms
